description: This file defines the Activity class in the Opencart e-commerce platform, specifically within the catalog controller event namespace. The class contains multiple methods that hook into various customer-related actions (such as adding a customer, editing details, login, password change, address modifications, etc.) to record user activity for analytics or logging purposes. It interacts with models to add activity logs when certain customer events occur.

classes.name: Activity
classes.description: Controller class that tracks various customer activities such as registration, login, profile updates, address changes, transactions, and order status updates, by listening to specific trigger points post-actions in the shopping platform.

methods.name: addCustomer
methods.description: Logs activity when a new customer registers, capturing customer ID and name if activity tracking is enabled.

methods.name: editCustomer
methods.description: Logs activity when a customer updates their profile, capturing customer ID and name.

methods.name: editPassword
methods.description: Logs activity when a customer changes or resets their password, capturing customer ID and name.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Logs activity when a customer logs in, capturing customer ID and name, under specific route conditions.

methods.name: forgotten
methods.description: Logs activity when a customer initiates a password reset (forgotten password) process.

methods.name: addTransaction
methods.description: Logs activity when a customer adds a transaction, recording customer info and order ID.

methods.name: addAffiliate
methods.description: Logs activity when a customer becomes an affiliate.

methods.name: editAffiliate
methods.description: Logs activity when an affiliate's information is edited.

methods.name: addAddress
methods.description: Logs activity when a customer adds a new address.

methods.name: editAddress
methods.description: Logs activity when a customer edits an address.

methods.name: deleteAddress
methods.description: Logs activity when a customer deletes an address.

methods.name: addReturn
methods.description: Logs activity when a customer creates a return request, with differentiation for logged-in vs guest customers.

methods.name: addHistory
methods.description: Logs activity when an order status is updated, distinguishing between guest and registered customers.
